content.title: Bitcoin, gold, AI were key drivers of 2025's record ETF inflows
content.description:
Net inflows into exchange-traded funds (ETFs) totaled a record $1.03 trillion last year, and they're already set to break that record this year, currently sitting at $1.28 trillion year to date.

Amplify ETFs CEO, Christian Magoon, joins Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman to explain where money was going in 2025 and what ETF trends he anticipates next year.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

content.title: Cryptos’ Weak Pulse May Be Early Warning Sign. What the Charts of Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana Suggest
content.summary: After rocketing through six figures earlier this year,  Bitcoin  has entered a phase of cautious consolidation.  Institutional interest remains elevated, but traders are now watching closely to see whether the pullback is a healthy reset or the start of something more sinister.  Bitcoin remains one of the market’s favorite risk on barometers, and its recent weakness may be the canary in the coal mine on that front.
